originating_prompt:
On the partner portal page (surz_partner_portal), add a "Your referral performance" infographic under the "Orders claimed with my code" heading, in the Claude Design style of this site (Surzion navy #0E2358, blue #2F6BE6, Poppins):

- a bar chart of the signed-in partner's claimed orders per month (last 6 months), and the discount they gave per month as a second series,
- a big "Total your followers saved" number that counts up when the card appears,
- hovering a bar shows that month's orders and savings.

Use the partner's real claimed orders (surz_partner_order), not sample numbers, and show a friendly empty state when there are none yet. No standard block draws this, so build it the way the platform expects for that.
result_summary:
Need the surz_partner_order columns and how the T data source filters to the signed-in partner.I added the "Your referral performance" infographic to `surz_partner_portal` as a `custom_code` block. I haven't opened the page in preview, so none of it has been checked on screen or against real data.

**What it does**
- **Placement:** it sits right under the "Orders claimed with my code" heading and its note, above the order filter. It is visible to the `partner` role only.
- **Chart:** a Chart.js bar chart for the last 6 months. Orders claimed is the navy series and discount given is the blue series. Discount is on its own right-hand axis because the two numbers are on very different scales.
- **Count-up:** the "Total your followers saved" number counts up when the card fades in.
- **Hover:** hovering a month shows that month's orders and savings.
- **Style:** Poppins, #0E2358 and #2F6BE6, white card with rounded corners.
- **Real data:** it reads `surz_partner_order` through a new page data source, `ds_claimed_orders`. Orders and savings are added up by order month from `ORDER_DATE` and `DISCOUNT_AMT`.
- **Empty state:** with no claimed orders in the last 6 months it shows "No claimed orders yet" with a short explanation. A load failure shows a "Could not load your performance" message.

**Things to check**
- The data source has no filter for the signed-in partner. I'm relying on `surz_partner_order` being limited to the partner's own orders, as the existing orders list embed on this page is. Please confirm in preview that only the signed-in partner's orders are counted.
- Amounts are shown in ₹.
- The data source fetches at most 1,000 orders, newest first.
- This relies on live data access, so it works on the live page but not on a published static site.

I didn't update `requirement_doc.md`, since the project has none.

The only file touched is `Metadata_Model/page_models/model_surz_partner_portal.json`.
